messages:
olivia: Heads-up — running into flaky streaming reconnects from the Android Kotlin SDK when hitting our private VPC endpoint through the corporate HTTP proxy. Streams drop after ~45s, client then retries and sometimes gets 502. Anyone seen this with keepalive/proxy combos?

raj: for context — is this the managed private endpoint or the on-prem package?

olivia: managed private (VPC). Using the customer-configured proxy (NTLM) that sits in front of the NAT. Happens on Pixel and emulator in CI.

ben: our Android HTTP stacks (OkHttp) will use proxy tunnelling vs plain proxy depending on `CONNECT`. If proxy closes idle connections that can drop the websocket/stream. Are you using websockets or HTTP/2 streaming?

olivia: HTTP/2 streaming via our SDK. Example config (simplified):
```kotlin
val client = RedwoodClient.Builder()
  .baseUrl("https://private-api.redwood.internal")
  .proxy(Proxy(Proxy.Type.HTTP, InetSocketAddress("corp-proxy", 8080)))
  .keepAliveSeconds(60)
  .build()
```

android-team-bot: Note: mobile proxy chains + HTTP/2 downgrade on some carriers/firmwares are known to break long-lived streams. See docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/vpc-proxy-mobile

raj: couple quick checks: 1) can you reproduce with `curl --http2 --no-buffer` through the same proxy from a workstation? 2) can you toggle keepAliveSeconds to 20 and 120 to see if behavior correlates with idle timeout?

olivia: good idea — will try curl from a workstation on corp network. One weird thing: when it fails the first retry sometimes lands on the hosted fallback (which we expect) but sometimes returns a 502 from private endpoint.

ben: 502 probably from the proxy or the private front. Can you capture a tcpdump or OkHttp event logs? OkHttp event listener will show connection reuse and if it tries `CONNECT` vs `GET` upgrade.

olivia: attaching minimal OkHttp logs below (copied):
```
--> GET /v1/stream HTTP/2
--> CONNECT corp-proxy:8080
<-- 200 Connection established
<-- SETTINGS
<-- RST_STREAM errorCode=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
# then reconnect sequence
```

infra-ops: Proxy team chiming in — corp-proxy config has aggressive idle cleanup at 45s for tunneled connections. We can bump but want to understand app side retries first.

olivia: thanks — looks like 45s matches. If proxy aggressively tears down the tunnel mid-stream the client will see a reset and then our retry logic sometimes replays to private endpoint incorrectly.

raj: recommendation: 1) short-term: lower client keepalive to 20s and enable HTTP/2 PING/keepalive so proxy sees activity. 2) medium: make retry-on-reset behavior prefer fallback routing header so the first retry hits hosted fallback not private (avoid hitting torn tunnel). 3) infra: can you relax tunnel timeout to 5m for a canary org?

ben: code note — OkHttp has `connectionSpec` + `pingIntervalMillis`. Use `client.newBuilder().pingInterval(Duration.ofSeconds(20))` for HTTP/2 pings. Also set `retryOnConnectionFailure(true)` and add an `Authenticator` for NTLM if needed.

olivia: testing pingInterval now. If that works I'll open a small SDK patch to default pingInterval when baseUrl is private/internal and a proxy is detected.

infra-ops: we can do 5m for one customer. @ben / @raj please coordinate rollback plan if anything breaks.

olivia: thanks all — will post results in this thread after trying curl + pingInterval + smaller keepalive. :thumbsup:
